brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two adjacent cells piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full each with bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full - demonstrated with fork/spoon props
Parts are 3D-printed plastic; configurator checks fit/collisions only and cannot verify watertightness, sealing, or material waterproof ratings. Shape provides open bins but not certified waterproof.

Dishwasher safety depends on filament material, temperature resistance, and food-safety certification - none verified by configurator. User must choose suitable material and review manufacturer guidance.

finish.summary: Built compact 2-cell holder (2x full-depth bins side-by-side, joint-locked and capped). Provides utensil-holder form with dressing; waterproof and dishwasher-safe claims cannot be met by the configurator - require user material choice outside this system.

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.

- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
